parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: State which label represents the valve that prevents the backflow of blood from the aorta into the ventricle.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Name the blood vessel that carries oxygenated blood from the lungs to the heart **and** state which label represents this blood vessel.

parts.label: (a)(iii)
parts.text: State **precisely** where the sinoatrial node is located.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain the role of the atrioventricular node in the coordination of heart action.
